page_title: Chat with the best AI, privately or in a group chat. Explore GPT-6-Astra, Claude-Opus-5.5, Claude-Fable-5.1, Gemini-4-Argon, Grok-4.7, and thousands of others, all on Poe.

sources.entry: Poe - Platform that lets you chat with multiple AI models in one place. #freemium

summary.name: Poe
summary.one_liner: Poe is a platform for chatting with many AI models, both privately and in group chats, from a single site.
use_cases: chat with several AI models in one place
summary.what_it_does: The page lists a large catalogue of AI models available on Poe, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Mistral and Kimi model names, plus image models such as GPT-Image and Nano-Banana. It says users can chat privately or in a group chat. The page itself is mostly a model list and cookie consent text, so it gives few details on how the service works or what each model costs. The listing describes it as a platform that lets you chat with multiple AI models in one place.
notable: Access to many AI models from different providers in one interface
Private chats and group chats with AI
Lists image-generation models alongside chat models
caveats: Page does not state which features or models require a paid tier
Model availability and names on the page are not independently verified
